Enum EnumEDIStandardExtended

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumEDIStandardExtended>
      • EnumEDIStandardExtended
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumEDIStandardExtended>

    public enum EnumEDIStandardExtended
extends Enum<EnumEDIStandardExtended>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration EDI standard extended (A118).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
